text:
Maya K.: FYI we pushed a concise update to the Employee Handbook (Facilities & Remote Work) this AM. Key bits: clarified contractor building access, updated hot-desk booking rules, and a minimum onsite expectation (2 days/month) with manager exceptions. Please read and acknowledge by next Mon.

Devon P.: quick q: contractor access change scope? global or region-limited?

Lia (People Ops): Global policy but implementation varies. EOR-managed contractors get standard access where our EOR partner supports it; otherwise we issue guest access windows. We included an appendix with country notes. If someone needs constant access, file an exception request through people-ops.

Devon P.: got it, thanks.

Sam W.: where do managers sign up for the Q&A drop-ins?

hr_bot: Manager Q&A signup: https://forms.redwood.co/fw-qanda  Sessions next Tue/Wed (PST). Add to calendar using the confirmation email.

Lia (People Ops): also running 30-min localized compliance briefings for offices with special lease/legal requirements (APAC/EMEA localized notes). Use the same form to select localized session.

Maya K.: can we get an RSVP/exportable list? would like to track manager acknowledgements across teams.

hr_bot: RSVP CSV: https://storage.redwood.co/fw-rsvps-2109.csv

Lia (People Ops): Manager quick checklist to paste into 1:1s: - confirm you read the update (link in form) - mark team as acknowledged in HR portal - escalate 24/7 access requests to people-ops - schedule localized briefing if needed

Sam W.: one manager asked for a 1-day/month exception due to visa constraints. will open an exception ticket.

Lia (People Ops): noted. we will flag countries requiring legal signoff and run 1:1 briefings instead of group sessions for those. Draft contractor FAQ coming EOD and will be attached to the policy doc.

Maya K.: great, thanks all. Lia — can you post the localized checklists when ready?

Lia (People Ops): yes, will drop checklists and FAQ in this thread when available. Reminder set: acknowledgements due next Mon 17:00 PST.

Devon P.: thanks, adding to team agenda.
